meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: 帮你为某个会话渠道创建第一个 NanoClaw agent:读取你在该渠道的用户身份,把私信消息组接到新 agent,并通过正常投递路径发出欢迎私信。整套操作可重复运行。
howto.when: 在渠道凭据已配置、服务正在运行之后使用;它会先确认服务状态与适配器连接,再让你选择承载欢迎私信的渠道。

say.text: 帮我为第一个 NanoClaw agent 选渠道并创建它
say.note: 先问选哪个渠道,再让你填渠道用户 id 等身份信息

say.text: 先确认服务在运行、适配器已经连上
欢迎私信两分钟没到,帮我排查投递

howto.what_en: Guides you through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel: it resolves your channel identity, wires the DM messaging group to a new agent, and sends a welcome DM through the normal delivery path. Reruns are safe.
howto.when_en: Use it after channel credentials are configured and the service is running; it first checks service status and adapter connection, then asks which channel should host the welcome DM.

say_en.text: Create the first NanoClaw agent for a channel I pick
say_en.note: It asks which channel, then for your channel user id and names

say_en.text: Check that the service is running and the adapter is connected
say_en.note: Checks launchctl/systemctl status and connection lines in the log

say_en.text: The welcome DM hasn't arrived in two minutes, help me debug
say_en.note: Looks for pending rows in outbound.db and errors in the log
